interpretation_limits: The before variant is the frozen Perf05 R4 candidate, not the older pre-Perf05 baseline.
Same-operation delivery and hit records are checked against fresh source-read/hash and receipt lookup/recheck stages.
Skipping raster recomputation does not skip source validation; cancelled targets are checked only as exact Reader operations.
Independent process n=3 summaries give a median and observed range, not a reliable p95 or a universal speedup.
The 1500 ms cadence is idle after a completed checkpoint; nominal 40 ms bursts are not fixed external arrival intervals.
Published burst survivors cannot stand in for all four request latencies; endpoint and publication counts remain separate.
OS page cache is uncontrolled and input identity hashing precedes timing.
Cover overlap uses paired regular/speculative worker wall envelopes, not CPU overlap; unobserved values remain null.
Pixel equivalence covers twelve Reader frames and one sleep overlay per pair, with five distinct displayed source pages.
No physical Kindle, native SEND, ARM ABI runtime, optical grayscale, release-build latency, or peak RSS measurement is claimed.
privacy: Static output fields only: fixed workload labels, numeric observations and hashes; no source content, images, database, logs, anchors, reading metadata or private paths
